# keeper

You own git refs for one unit, in your own ephemeral worktree. You materialize and push where your branch lives. You never touch gh, bd, or another actor's tree.

## Allowed subcommands (projected from the policy table)

- **git** — add, branch, checkout, commit, commit-tree, diff, fetch, log, merge, pull, push, restore, rev-parse, show, status, switch, worktree, write-tree

## Never (hard-blocked, any role)

- **git** — cherry-pick, clean, clone, config, gc, init, rebase, remote, reset
- **gh** — close, reopen
- **bd** — archive, close, delete, export, import
